video_title: Anthony Edwards Took The Timberwolves To Paris .... It Got Crazy!

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: the high resale value of Chrome Hearts gear in the US
quotes.excerpt: the resale on this stuff when you get back home is crazy
quotes.quote: I just left Chrome Hearts. They got a whole bunch of stuff at this one actually. And as you guys know, the resale on this stuff when you get back home is crazy. Basically everything out here, if you have a passport, is 10% off. I'll be going back to the hotel to get into the van to go practice and shoot around with the guys and everything.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: the unique experience of bringing the entire NBA team to Paris
quotes.excerpt: we never done anything like this since I've been in the NBA
quotes.quote: We only got two, three more days out here in Paris left, but it's been a great experience. We never done anything like this since I've been in the NBA. So just being able to get everybody to come out the country for one, I think is a big deal to get that many guys on the same page is amazing. And then two, it's just been dope to experience a new thing. I've never been to Europe before, so this was like a great introduction. Obviously Rudy Gobert had the red carpet rolled out, so we've done a whole bunch of dope stuff.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: the historical connection between King Louis XIII and Hennessy
quotes.excerpt: Hennessy and the King partnered together to make some Louis
quotes.quote: I just found out Louis XIII came from here. So Hennessy and the King partnered together to make some Louis. I don't think, but yeah, when I do drink that's going to be my thing. Louis XIII.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: questioning if Louis XIII bottles are worth the high price
quotes.excerpt: I just want to know, do Louis gets perpetuity for his bottles?
quotes.quote: We in Louis's private sector now. I just want to know, do Louis gets perpetuity for his bottles? We just looked up, this is 12 bands a bottle. If Louis not collecting, I'm going to get a legal team together. We going to go stand up for my boy Louis.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards and teammates joking about driving a tractor in France

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Clark
text_blocks.text: Oh my god. Yeah, drive the tractor.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Clark
text_blocks.text: No, I can't drive. You're French. You drive.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Clark
text_blocks.text: You do have a license. You're the King of France.

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Clark
text_blocks.text: You the prodigy. Giannis would drive it.
